title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Handler Exception Close Work Item
summary: Map unexpected accepted WebSocket application handler exceptions to a WebSocket internal-error close frame and orderly write completion.
planned_changes:
- Catch unexpected handler exceptions inside the accepted WebSocket branch after response headers are written.
- Write a best-effort 1011 `internal error` close frame and complete writes without escalating the failure to the connection loop.
- Add a loopback HTTP/3 server test that observes the 1011 close frame and FIN after a synthetic handler exception.
verification_plan: Run the focused HTTP/3 minimal server WebSocket handler-exception test, adjacent WebSocket regression tests, core SpecTrace validation, regenerated QUIC requirement triage, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: QUIC transport runtime, ACK, recovery, pacing, or packet-protection changes.
completion_notes: Unexpected accepted WebSocket handler exceptions now produce a best-effort 1011 close frame and do not tear down the HTTP/3 connection path through an uncaught application exception.
